name: Darrowshire: Hearthglen
interpretationNote: Original generated Classic Plaguelands illustration for Hearthglen. Recognizable version traits: Classic Hearthglen is a fortified human settlement: pale stone and timber, practical defenses and red-white Scarlet Crusade banners against damaged fields. Do not confuse it with Stormwind Keep. The scene is interpretive art, not a screenshot, exact model, surveyed coordinate, quest object placement or route. Matching-game-build comparison remains open; see docs/research/darrowshire-lost-and-remembered-visual-assets.json.
